blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE : Stoic is launching world sales ahead of the AFM on Paradise Disturbed , which will see Mindhunter star Holt McCallany return to the serial killer genre.

Stoic will be screening the completed film directed by James Khanlarian ( The Ghost Trap ) and based on the novel by James Robert Fuller. Also starring are Zak Steiner ( Euphoria ), Lily Donoghue ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ), and Xander Berkeley ( Apollo 13 ).

blocks.text: The pic follows retired legendary investigator Ron Lee (McCallany), who is pulled back into the dark world he had walked away from when a series of ritualistic murders target him. A tense cat-and-mouse game unfolds as Ron matches wits with a brilliant and sadistic killer who is waiting to unleash their final masterpiece in this game of death. Below is a first-look image.

Paradise Disturbed is produced by April Aguilera, Couture, and Khanlarian. The film was a collaboration between Khanlarian Entertainment and Sweet Kop Films, with Larry Mortorff, Barry Krost, and Jonathan Clay Harris as executive producers.

blocks.text: “I can honestly say that working on Paradise Disturbed with this team was one of the most rewarding experiences I’ve had,” said writer-producer Peter A. Couture II. “I can’t give Holt enough credit; he became Ron Lee.”
